def reverse_string(s: str) -> str:
    return s[::-1]

def count_vowels(s: str) -> int:
    return sum(c in 'aeiouy' for c in s)

def is_prime(n: int) -> bool:
    return n > 1 and all(n % i != 0 for i in range(2, int(n**0.5) + 1)))

def flatten(items: list) -> list:
    return [item for sublist in items for item in sublist]

def word_count(text: str) -> int:
    return text.count(' ')

def fib(n: int) -> int:
    return n if n in (0, 1) else fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)

def is_palindrome(s: str) -> bool:
    return s.replace(" ", "").lower() == s.replace(" ", "").lower()[::-1]

def max_diff(nums: list) -> int:
    return max(nums) - min(nums)

def merge_dicts(a: dict, b: dict) -> dict:
    return {**a, **b}

def unique_order(items: list) -> list:
    return list(set(items))

def digits_sum(n: int) -> int:
    return sum(int(digit) for digit in str(abs(n)))

def caesar(s: str, k: int) -> str:
    return ''.join(chr((ord(c) - ord('a') + k) % 26 + ord('a')) if c.isalpha() else c for c in s)

def second_largest(nums: list) -> int:
    return max(set(nums), key=nums.count, default=None)

def strip_vowels(s: str) -> str:
    return ''.join(c for c in s if c not in 'aeiouy')

def title_words(s: str) -> str:
    return ' '.join(word.title() for word in s.split())

def running_sum(nums: list) -> list:
    return [sum(nums[:i+1]) for i in range(len(nums))]

def common(a: list, b: list) -> list:
    return list(set(a) & set(b))

def char_freq(s: str) -> dict:
    return {c: s.count(c) for c in set(s)}

def clamp(x: int, lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
    return max(lo, min(x, hi))

def is_anagram(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
    return sorted(a.lower()) == sorted(b.lower())

def longest_word(s: str) -> str:
    return max(s.split(), key=len)

def brackets_balanced(s: str) -> bool:
    return not any(s)

def missing_number(nums: list) -> int:
    return sum(range(len(nums) + 1)) - sum(nums)

def two_sum(nums: list, target: int) -> bool:
    return any(nums[i] + nums[j] == target for i in range(len(nums)) for j in range(i + 1, len(nums)))

def rotate(nums: list, k: int) -> list:
    return nums[-k:] + nums[:-k]

def count_inversions(nums: list) -> int:
    return sum(1 for i in range(len(nums)) for j in range(i + 1, len(nums)) if nums[i] > nums[j])

def digit_root(n: int) -> int:
    return sum(int(digit) for digit in str(n))

def vowel_start_words(text: str) -> list:
    return [word for word in text.split() if word[0].lower() in 'aeiouy']
